title: New Combat Behaviour
intro: Total overhaul of how AI behaves in individual combat: aim, morale, suppression, cover, grenades and personality. This is the core of DCO_AI.

title: Squad AI & Command Layer
intro: Squad-level coordination, communication and shared awareness. Turns groups of individuals into cohesive tactical units.

title: Vehicle Combat Overhaul
intro: Vehicles as active combat assets: support by fire, transport, mechanized assaults and resupply.

title: Battlegroup & High Command
intro: An autonomous AI commander that captures objectives, coordinates battlegroups, dispatches QRF, keeps reserves and calls in artillery.

title: Logistics & Resupply
intro: Soldiers keep themselves in the fight: finding the right ammo, using arsenals and scavenging from the fallen.

title: Core AI Foundation
intro: Engine-level fixes and shared systems every other feature builds on.

title: GM / Zeus Toolkit
intro: Tune DCO_AI live from the Game Master editor, globally or per unit. Built for mission makers and server owners.

title: DCO Game Mode
intro: Game modes built around the DCO AI commander: Conflict-style warfare, Capture & Hold and PvE.
